About FoodChain ID


FoodChain ID is a global leader in food safety, regulatory compliance, and sustainability solutions. We support organizations across the food and agriculture value chain with certification, advisory, and data\-driven services that help bring safe, compliant, and sustainable products to market.


About the Role


You will own the regional go\-to\-market offers for our India and Thailand business units, by either working with others on the Product Marketing team where the product fits the region, and building offers specific to APAC where local buyer needs, regulations, or competitive dynamics call for something different. This role will initially focus on our business in India and Thailand, and potentially expand into other Asian markets as the business requires.


We are looking for a Product Marketing Manager, APAC to be the regional voice and hands\-on executor of go\-to\-market across our fastest\-growing markets. As part of the Product Marketing team, you will take positioning, messaging, and portfolio strategy and adapt it so it lands with food and beverage, agriculture, and compliance buyers in each of these markets.


This role sits at the intersection of marketing, regional sales and operations, and the on\-the\-ground realities of doing business across South and Southeast Asia. Your first job is to become the person who understands how buyers in these markets think, buy, and compete, better than anyone else on the team. Your second is to use that fluency to localize launches, sharpen enablement, and make sure the region’s voice shapes companywide strategy rather than just receiving it.


This is an individual contributor role that requires equal strength in regional market fluency and hands\-on localization and execution, while working with your marketing and sales peers to ensure alignment.


What You’ll Own


Regional Go\-to\-Market Execution

* Adapt global positioning, messaging, and launch plans for our India and Thailand business units, tailoring them to each market’s buyer needs, regulatory environment, and competitive landscape.
* Own the regional launch calendar, sequencing global product and portfolio launches across markets based on commercial priority and market readiness.
* Partner with regional sales, and operations to align on shared go\-to\-market plans and launch objectives.
* Track regional launch performance and adjust plans market by market.
* Lead regional event strategy, working with our events management team to plan and execute conferences, trade shows, and customer events across APAC.
* Collaborate with growth marketing on executing regional campaigns and other demand generation activities that support pipeline goals across APAC.


Localization \& Regional Enablement

* Localize sales materials, solution content, case studies, and campaigns for language, cultural, and regulatory nuance across APAC.
* Equip regional sales and operations with assets that are aligned with the buying behavior.
* Serve as the go\-to regional expert on how FoodChain ID’s food safety, compliance, and sustainability portfolio applies to APAC buyers.


Regional Market \& Customer Insight

* Monitor regional regulatory change, industry trends, and competitor activity market by market.
* Act as the conduit between the region and the rest of product marketing and the broader marketing organization, bringing companywide strategy into the region and feeding field insight back up.


Cross\-Functional \& Regional Partnership

* Build trusted relationships with APAC sales, operations, and country leaders, as well as marketing peers.
* Represent APAC’s needs in portfolio planning, helping prioritize which assets and campaigns get localized first.
* Coordinate across time zones and cultures to keep regional and global teams aligned without direct authority.


What You Bring

* 5–7\+ years in product marketing, or a related commercial role at a B2B technology, data, or services company, ideally supporting APAC or another multi\-country region.
* Direct experience marketing to or working within India, or Thailand; understanding of regional buyer behavior, business culture, and go\-to\-market norms across South and Southeast Asia strongly preferred.
* Experience with food safety, regulatory compliance, agri\-food, or adjacent domains is a plus.
* Fluency in English required; proficiency in Hindi, Thai, or Vietnamese is a strong plus.
* Comfort adapting global positioning and assets to local market realities, rather than creating positioning from a blank page.
* A track record of building trust with regional sales and country leaders as well as peers across the marketing organization, and influencing across markets, functions, and levels without direct authority.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication across cultures, able to shift register between a regional channel partner, a compliance buyer, and a marketing leader in the same day.
* Strong project management instincts and the independence to operate across multiple markets and time zones.
* A data\-driven, curious approach, with willingness to travel within the region as needed.


How Success Is Measured

* Regional pipeline and revenue influenced by localized go\-to\-market efforts across markets.
* Speed and quality of adapting global launches to each APAC market
* Adoption of regional enablement assets by local sales
* Regional win\-rate improvement and market share growth across markets
* Strength of the feedback loop from the region into companywide product marketing strategy

 As an Analyst within the Global Technology Controllers in Corporate Sector Controllers, you will be responsible for providing controllership support to the technology function, including accounting for technology in accordance with US GAAP and JPMC standards.
   

  

 Global Technology Controller provide controllership support to technology function in to Hardware, Software, Professional services and other direct expense lines. Team is also responsible for capitalization of tangible or intangible assets.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Determine expense versus capitalization treatment, ensure timely disposal recognition, and post close entries with appropriate support and approvals.

* Ensure balance sheet positions are appropriately supported to maintain a strong fortress balance sheet.

Reports To: Director of Field Marketing, India


The Opportunity


As the Nutanix Commercial Field Marketing Manager, you will be the primary marketing engine driving scalable demand generation, pipeline acceleration, and market penetration across Nutanix’s India commercial segment.


Reporting directly to the Director of Field Marketing, India, you will sit at the intersection of commercial sales, demand generation, partner marketing, and sales engagement. In this high\-impact role, you will take ownership of designing and executing full\-funnel marketing programs that reach commercial audiences at scale and convert engagement into measurable business outcomes.


You will work closely with Commercial Sales leaders, Account Executives, Inside Sales, channel partners, the APJ marketing team, and the Global Demand Center to build repeatable programs that position Nutanix as the platform of choice for hybrid multicloud, cloud\-native applications, and Enterprise AI.


About the Team


You will be part of the vibrant India Field Marketing organisation, working in lockstep with local commercial sales leadership, the channel ecosystem, the APJ team, and Global Demand Center.


We operate in a fast\-paced, data\-informed environment where bold ideas, experimentation, and collaborative execution are central to how we build impactful marketing programs. The team combines strategic planning with hands\-on execution to create demand, accelerate pipeline, and strengthen Nutanix’s position in the Indian market.


Your Role (What You’ll Do)

* Build \& Execute the Commercial Demand Engine: Develop and lead integrated marketing plans for India’s commercial segment across digital campaigns, email, webinars, third\-party demand generation, seminars, workshops, and partner programs.
* Pipeline Generation \& Velocity: Own the commercial marketing target and partner closely with Commercial Sales leaders, Account Executives, and Inside Sales to build quarterly pipeline generation and acceleration plans.
* Scale Digital \& Lifecycle Programs: Create repeatable programs that acquire, engage, nurture, and re\-engage prospects and customers, with a focus on whitespace, net\-new logo acquisition, and measurable funnel progression.
* Drive Ecosystem Co\-Marketing: Work with resellers, distributors, system integrators, service providers, and technology partners to develop joint go\-to\-market programs that extend reach and generate partner\-sourced pipeline.
* Curate High\-Impact Commercial Experiences: Plan and deliver regional events, partner\-led activities, customer and prospect workshops, user groups, webinars, and other experiences that create meaningful sales engagement—not just attendance.
* Localize \& Contextualize Narratives: Translate global campaigns into relevant India\-focused messaging that addresses commercial customer priorities, including cloud modernization, infrastructure simplification, hybrid multicloud, cloud\-native applications, competitive displacement, and Enterprise AI adoption.
* Analytics \& Optimization: Monitor campaign performance, funnel progression, pipeline contribution, and program ROI using Salesforce, marketing automation, and analytics platforms. Test and optimize programs to improve quality, conversion, and efficiency.
* Advocate Customer Success: Identify and cultivate referenceable customers, testimonials, speakers, and local success stories that strengthen Nutanix’s value proposition across India.
* Manage Execution Excellence: Own program planning, budgets, agencies, vendors, timelines, follow\-up processes, and stakeholder communications across multiple concurrent initiatives.

What You Will Bring

* 6–9 years of B2B technology marketing experience, with specific experience in field marketing, demand generation, integrated campaigns, or commercial marketing.
* A proven track record of developing and executing high\-impact marketing programs that deliver measurable leads, meetings, opportunities, and pipeline.
* Strong understanding of commercial or mid\-market audiences and the ability to build programs that work across direct, digital, and partner\-led routes to market.
* Practical knowledge of the B2B sales funnel, lead management, campaign attribution, nurture, and sales follow\-up processes.
* Experience planning and executing digital programs, webinars, third\-party demand generation, seminars, workshops, regional events, and partner activities.
* Demonstrated ability to build strong relationships with Sales leaders, Account Executives, Inside Sales, channel teams, partners, APJ stakeholders, and global marketing teams.
* Hands\-on experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms such as Salesforce and Marketo; familiarity with campaign reporting and analytics is essential.
* Strong project management, budget management, prioritization, agency, and vendor\-management skills.
* Familiarity with enterprise software, SaaS, cloud, data center, infrastructure, or cybersecurity technologies, with the curiosity to learn complex technical solutions quickly.
* A data\-driven, results\-oriented mindset with the ability to analyze performance, communicate insights, and make clear recommendations.
* A creative thinker, team player, detail\-oriented, self\-motivated, and effective communicator who can thrive in a fast\-paced, changing environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field. An MBA is a plus.

Work Arrangement


Hybrid: This role operates in a hybrid capacity, blending the benefits of remote work with the advantages of in\-person collaboration.


In India offices (Mumbai, Bangalore, Pune), employees are expected to work onsite a minimum of 3 days per week to foster team alignment, collaboration, and access to in\-office resources.
